claim_rules.wings: Interpretive secondary feature; Hook et al. found little supporting research for secondary propositions.
claim_rules.subtypes: Tradition-dependent construct; sample-specific inventory studies do not establish universal validity.
claim_rules.countertype: Present only as a disputed/tradition-specific interpretation.
claim_rules.application: Self-reflection and communication hypotheses only; not diagnosis, selection, or outcome prediction.

source_policy.academic: Peer-reviewed or official bibliographic sources support evidence-boundary claims only.
